name: r7_feist8_mid32
description: 8-round Feistel, F linear = 32-bit Midori almost-MDS (2x4-nibble columns), val^key whitening
composition: val^key whitening -> 8x Feistel round (L,R = R, L^F(R,rk)), F = S-box(S1) -> Midori32 (per 16-bit half: y[i]=XOR of other 3 nibbles) -> S-box(S1) -> ^rk32; out={R,L}; rk = rotl64(k,13(i+1))^(i+1)*GOLDEN
